# Hilton
> Global hospitality platform for searching, booking, and managing stays across Hilton’s hotel brands, resorts, and loyalty program.

Hilton.com is the primary consumer site for Hilton’s worldwide portfolio of hotels and resorts. It provides hotel search, destination and brand directories, Hilton Honors loyalty information, special offers, meetings and events resources, and travel planning tools for leisure and business travelers.

## Hotel Search & Booking
- [Find a Hotel](https://www.hilton.com/en/locations/): Browse Hilton hotels worldwide by destination, brand, and travel preferences.
- [Hotels by Destination](https://www.hilton.com/en/locations/): Explore country, city, and regional hotel directories across Hilton’s global network.
- [Resorts](https://www.hilton.com/en/locations/resorts/): Discover resort properties for beach, golf, spa, and family vacations.
- [Pet-Friendly Hotels](https://www.hilton.com/en/locations/pet-friendly/): Find Hilton hotels that welcome pets in destinations worldwide.
- [Airport Hotels](https://www.hilton.com/en/locations/airport-hotels/): Search hotels near major airports for convenient overnight and business stays.
- [EV Charging Hotels](https://www.hilton.com/en/locations/ev-charging/): Locate Hilton properties offering electric vehicle charging amenities.
- [Spa Hotels](https://www.hilton.com/en/locations/spa/): Browse hotels and resorts featuring spa and wellness facilities.

## Hilton Honors
- [Hilton Honors](https://www.hilton.com/en/hilton-honors/): Learn about Hilton’s loyalty program, member benefits, and earning opportunities.
- [Join Hilton Honors](https://www.hilton.com/en/hilton-honors/join/): Enroll in Hilton Honors to earn points and access member perks.
- [Hilton Honors Benefits](https://www.hilton.com/en/hilton-honors/member-benefits/): Review tier benefits including discounts, digital check-in, and room selection.
- [Hilton Honors Points](https://www.hilton.com/en/hilton-honors/points/): Understand how to earn, redeem, and use Hilton Honors points.
- [Hilton Honors Experiences](https://www.hiltonhonors.com/en_US/experiences/): Redeem points for events, entertainment, dining, and travel experiences.
- [Hilton Honors Credit Cards](https://www.hilton.com/en/hilton-honors/credit-cards/): Compare co-branded credit cards that help members earn Hilton Honors points.

## Brands
- [Hilton Hotels & Resorts](https://www.hilton.com/en/brands/hilton-hotels-and-resorts/): Flagship full-service brand for business and leisure travel worldwide.
- [Waldorf Astoria Hotels & Resorts](https://www.hilton.com/en/brands/waldorf-astoria/): Luxury hotels and resorts focused on personalized service and iconic destinations.
- [Conrad Hotels & Resorts](https://www.hilton.com/en/brands/conrad-hotels-and-resorts/): Contemporary luxury brand with premium stays in major cities and resorts.
- [Canopy by Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/brands/canopy-by-hilton/): Lifestyle hotels with neighborhood-inspired design and local experiences.
- [Curio Collection by Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/brands/curio-collection-by-hilton/): Distinctive upscale hotels selected for unique character and independent style.
- [DoubleTree by Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/brands/doubletree-by-hilton/): Full-service hotels known for warm hospitality and broad global coverage.
- [Embassy Suites by Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/brands/embassy-suites-by-hilton/): All-suite hotels offering complimentary cooked-to-order breakfast and evening reception.
- [Hampton by Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/brands/hampton-by-hilton/): Midscale hotels focused on dependable stays and included breakfast.

## More Hilton Brands
- [Hilton Garden Inn](https://www.hilton.com/en/brands/hilton-garden-inn/): Upscale focused-service hotels for business and leisure travelers.
- [Homewood Suites by Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/brands/homewood-suites-by-hilton/): Extended-stay all-suite hotels with home-like amenities.
- [Home2 Suites by Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/brands/home2-suites-by-hilton/): Extended-stay brand with flexible suites and modern communal spaces.
- [Tempo by Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/brands/tempo-by-hilton/): Lifestyle brand centered on wellness, productivity, and modern travel.
- [Motto by Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/brands/motto-by-hilton/): Micro-hotel brand designed for urban stays and social travel.
- [Tru by Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/brands/tru-by-hilton/): Midscale brand with simplified essentials and vibrant common areas.
- [Spark by Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/brands/spark-by-hilton/): Premium economy conversion brand focused on value and consistency.
- [LXR Hotels & Resorts](https://www.hilton.com/en/brands/lxr-hotels-and-resorts/): Independent luxury properties emphasizing bespoke service and distinctive settings.

## Offers & Deals
- [Hotel Deals and Offers](https://www.hilton.com/en/offers/): Browse current promotions, packages, and discounted rates across Hilton brands.
- [Honors Discount Advance Purchase](https://www.hilton.com/en/offers/honors-discount-advance-purchase/): Save with prepaid member rates booked in advance.
- [2X Points Offers](https://www.hilton.com/en/offers/): Find promotions that award bonus Hilton Honors points on stays.
- [Resort Packages](https://www.hilton.com/en/offers/): Explore vacation packages and seasonal resort promotions.
- [AAA/CAA Rates](https://www.hilton.com/en/offers/): Access eligible discounted rates for AAA and CAA members.
- [Military Family Rate](https://www.hilton.com/en/offers/): Review special rates available to military members and families.

## Meetings, Events & Group Travel
- [Meetings & Events](https://www.hilton.com/en/events/): Plan meetings, conferences, weddings, and social events at Hilton properties.
- [Group Travel](https://www.hilton.com/en/p/group-travel/): Organize room blocks and bookings for groups traveling together.
- [Business Travel](https://www.hilton.com/en/business-travel/): Explore programs and tools for corporate travel management.
- [Weddings](https://www.hilton.com/en/events/weddings/): Discover wedding venues, planning support, and celebration packages.
- [EventReady with CleanStay](https://www.hilton.com/en/events/): Review event planning resources and hospitality standards for meetings.

## Travel Inspiration & Destinations
- [Hilton Stories](https://stories.hilton.com/): Read travel inspiration, brand news, destination features, and hospitality stories.
- [Resort Destinations](https://www.hilton.com/en/locations/resorts/): Explore resort-focused destinations for leisure and vacation planning.
- [Beach Hotels](https://www.hilton.com/en/locations/beach/): Find beachfront and coastal Hilton properties around the world.
- [Boutique Hotels](https://www.hilton.com/en/locations/boutique/): Browse boutique and distinctive hotels across select Hilton brands.
- [Luxury Hotels](https://www.hilton.com/en/locations/luxury/): Discover luxury stays from Waldorf Astoria, Conrad, LXR, and other premium brands.
- [New Hotels](https://www.hilton.com/en/locations/new-hotels/): See recently opened Hilton properties and new destinations.

## Customer Support & Account
- [Customer Support](https://help.hilton.com/): Access help articles for reservations, billing, Honors, and account issues.
- [Manage Your Stay](https://www.hilton.com/en/book/reservation/): View, change, or cancel an existing reservation online.
- [Digital Check-In](https://www.hilton.com/en/hilton-honors/member-benefits/): Learn about digital check-in and room selection for Honors members.
- [Contact Hilton](https://help.hilton.com/s/contactsupport): Reach Hilton support for booking, account, and property assistance.
- [Traveling with Pets](https://www.hilton.com/en/pet-friendly/): Review pet travel information and pet-friendly stay guidance.

## Programs & Partnerships
- [Hilton for Business](https://www.hilton.com/en/business-travel/): Business travel solutions for companies and frequent work travelers.
- [Travel Agents](https://www.hilton.com/en/travel-agents/): Resources and booking information for travel advisors and agents.
- [Hilton Gift Cards](https://www.buyhiltongiftcards.com/): Purchase gift cards redeemable at participating Hilton properties.
- [Hilton Grand Vacations](https://www.hiltongrandvacations.com/): Explore Hilton-affiliated vacation ownership and timeshare travel options.
- [Small Luxury Hotels of the World](https://www.hilton.com/en/brands/small-luxury-hotels-of-the-world/): Browse SLH properties participating in the Hilton ecosystem.
